layer: nested KWin 6.7.5, virtual backend (not physical); commands via kglobalaccel invokeShortcut (D-Bus command API, not input)
clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC via Plastile.Measure (tools/measure) inside KWin's QV4; fixture logs and the harness use the same clock

definitions.dispatchToLastRequestOuter: measurement root: ShortcutHandler.onActivated entry -> runtime.dispatch() returned, after every frame request of the command was issued (t1 -> t4); same span in both modes
definitions.innerDispatchToReturn: the runtime's own span inside dispatch() (instrumented only)
definitions.solve: engine solveAndApply: solve input + layout solve (instrumented only); apply: plan application, every frame write
definitions.requestToFirstConfigure/LastCommit/Virtu: last request -> first xdg configure received by any fixture / last commit answering a configure / wp_presentation time of that commit on the virtual backend's software timeline (not physical scanout)
definitions.sendToDispatch: harness D-Bus send -> handler entry (kglobalaccel path; not input latency)
definitions.warmup: declared before the run: the first block of 20 commands of every workload in every session

samplesFile.format: xz-compressed CSV, one row per command in dispatch order per run; empty = null. PERFORMANCE §8: fields constant within a run are in runs[runId]; dispatchNs = runs[runId].t0Ns + dispatchOffsetNs; lastRequestNs = dispatchNs + outerNs; sample = row index within the run. Window titles are never recorded.

nullFields.solveEndNs: the solve span is a duration (solveNs) inside solveAndApply; its absolute end is not logged
nullFields.observedNs: KWin-side frameGeometryChanged is not recorded in measured units (it would add a handler to every write); the frames diagnostic unit checks it per block; client configure/commit times are given
nullFields.presentedNs: nested virtual backend: no physical output (requestToVirtualPresentNs is the software timeline)
nullFields.nativeMutations: not counted per sample; Plastile's direct backend issues no native tile mutation (ADR-003)
nullFields.correctiveWrites: per block (engine counters), see units[].corrections and corrections[]

gcRate.note: QV4 collections are logged by KWin's process for every engine (Plastile's declarative engine and the harness's one-shot oracle scripts); only cycles inside measured blocks are counted, when no oracle runs

gcrate-n32-uninstrumented-r0.offsetSource: median of the instrumented units (same machine, no suspend during the campaign)

gcrate-n32-uninstrumented-r1.offsetSource: median of the instrumented units (same machine, no suspend during the campaign)

framesCheck.unit: qualify-n32-diag-frames (instrumented + passive frameGeometryChanged listener; never pooled)
framesCheck.note: family = command family (resize = ratio, swap, master, focus, context and layout = no-op); writes are the commands' plan writes; ledger corrections are counted by the engine separately (unit corrections)
